latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Free Video Generator — generate 30-second videos from text or uploaded product photos for free.
- Supports MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG uploads up to 200MB with cloud-based rendering and automatic session handling.
- No registration required: generates a free token for 100 credits valid 7 days on first use.
- Simple, prompt-based workflow — describe your video, upload files, and download the finished result in 1–2 minutes.
- Includes built-in error handling for token, credits, file size/format, and export issues.
- Designed for content creators who want ready-to-share videos without learning editing software or paying for tools.
